description:
Get the pin status of an issue panel (added by a Forge app) for multiple projects.

The operation is read-only and runs synchronously. Projects that do not exist, or that you do not have permission to access, are returned in the response with the panel reported as not pinned and the reason in the `error` field; the request itself still succeeds.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

requestBody.description: Forge module ID and the list of projects to check.

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request body is invalid.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have permission to administer Jira.

500.description: Returned if the pin status could not be read (server error).

summary: Get issue panel pin status for projects
